# Lane 2.221: the question's "Yes" takes a tap when it is drawn, and the wait never starts again

Builder's note, 2026-11-23, branch `lane/2.221-yes-takes-a-tap`. Not pushed (the lead pushes).

## Built (the look's four points)

1. The server keeps when a postpone, cancel, forfeit or put-back-on-its-date question was first asked, with the asking form's one-time token (`apps/web/src/server/question-times.ts`, test beside it); `callOffStep` (`games-area/call-off-step.ts`) takes that time, never the form's. A "Yes" too soon asks again KEEPING the first time, and the answer says how much wait is left (`readyInMs`). With scripts on, "Yes" is drawn not ready (`aria-disabled`, dashed edge, `data-resting`, `staff.css`) for exactly that long and takes the first tap after; a tap too soon sends nothing (`call-off-forms.tsx`). The form's `askedAt` field is gone.
2. The wait is now 1000 ms (was 800), so with scripts off a second tap at 800 or 900 ms on a "Yes" drawn where the button stood only asks.
3. A hand-made "confirmed" post: no question kept for its token, so asked; its own time is ignored.
4. A change refused because someone called the game off meanwhile (`game-now-cancelled`, `game-now-postponed`) is left as a notice and said beside the game (`SavedLine` with `kind="error"`, `role="alert"`), since the redrawn card may have no panel to say it in (`actions.ts`, `games-page.tsx`, `saved-line.tsx`). No new message: the sentences existed.

## Proved (`tests/browser/ask-first-test.mjs`, added to; 2.158's checks unchanged)

- 390 by touch, scripts on and off: two taps on one spot at 100, 300, 600, 900 ms change no game, for Postpone, Cancel the game, Record forfeit, Put it back (postponed) and Put it back on the schedule (cancelled: its one change, once).
- Scripts off: "Postpone" scrolled to exactly where "Yes" lands on the redrawn page, tapped again 800 ms later: the spot holds "Yes" and the game is still scheduled.
- "Yes" drawn not ready; tapped every 300 ms (each tap timed from the drawing, no drift) it is sent once, within 1.5 s; the taps too soon send nothing.
- A hand-made "Yes" (never asked, and the real one sent at once) with a minute-old time is asked again.
- The stale postpone says "Someone cancelled this game meanwhile…" beside the game, scripts on and off; accessibility checked.
